log_function: log a message to the pycolab Plot object for game engine users
consume_function: consume and retrieve all logged messages from the pycolab Plot object
create_logging_protocol: create a logging protocol for pycolab game entities to send messages to the UI
test_log_function: test the log function that appends messages to the Plot's log_messages list
test_consume_function: test the consume function that retrieves and clears logged messages from the Plot
